questions.subject: FILM_STUDIES
questions.learningObjective: Define and distinguish key film studies concepts
questions.stem: Which statement best defines Dissolve?

options.text: It is a gradual transition where one image fades out as another image fades in.
It is a transition where the image darkens to black or brightens from black.
It is a transition in which one shot pushes the previous shot off the screen.
It is a transition that removes a portion of time, creating a visible discontinuity.

questions.explanation: It is a gradual transition where one image fades out as another image fades in. This is precisely what Dissolve means; the alternatives describe Fade, Wipe, Jump cut, which are different ideas.
questions.hint: Recall the specific meaning of Dissolve.

questions.stem: How would you define Jump cut?

options.text: It is a gradual transition where one image fades out as another image fades in.
It is a transition where the image darkens to black or brightens from black.
It is a transition in which one shot pushes the previous shot off the screen.
It is a transition that removes a portion of time, creating a visible discontinuity.

questions.explanation: It is a transition that removes a portion of time, creating a visible discontinuity. This is precisely what Jump cut means; the alternatives describe Dissolve, Fade, Wipe, which are different ideas.
questions.hint: Recall the specific meaning of Jump cut.

provenance.author: film-bank-author
provenance.attestation: authored from first principles; no protected content used
